Porch Group is a leading vertical software and insurance platform and is positioned to be the best partner to help homebuyers move, maintain, and fully protect their homes. We offer differentiated products and services, with homeowners insurance at the center of this relationship. We differentiate and look to win in the massive and growing homeowners insurance opportunity by
 1) providing the best services for homebuyers
 2) led by advantaged underwriting in insurance
 3) to protect the whole home
 As a leader in the home services software-as-a-service (“SaaS”) space, we’ve built deep relationships with approximately 30 thousand companies that are key to the home-buying transaction, such as home inspectors, mortgage companies, and title companies.
 In 2020, Porch Group rang the Nasdaq bell and began trading under the ticker symbol PRCH. We are looking to build a truly great company and are JUST GETTING STARTED.
 Job Title: Quality Assurance Specialist
 Location: India
 Workplace Type: Remote

 Job Summary 
 The future is bright for the Porch Group , and we'd love for you to be a part of it as our Quality Assurance Specialist . 
 As a Quality Assurance Specialist , you will be responsible for evaluating customer interactions and providing coaching feedback that helps team members deliver a consistent and exceptional homeowner experience. This role serves as a key partner to frontline managers by identifying individual performance opportunities and supporting the successful execution of sales and service initiatives. This role leverages AI-powered quality and conversation intelligence tools, including Level AI, to evaluate customer interactions, identify coaching opportunities, and improve agent performance. The QA Specialist is expected to incorporate AI-generated insights into daily auditing, feedback delivery, and quality monitoring activities. Success in this role is measured through quality scores, improvements in agent metrics, coaching effectiveness, customer experience outcomes, and support of overall team performance goals. 
 What You Will Do As A Quality Assurance Specialist 

• Conduct quality assurance evaluations of customer interactions to assess adherence to company standards, sales processes, and customer experience expectations. 

• Deliver timely and actionable feedback to team members to reinforce strengths and improve performance. 

• Partner with managers to identify coaching opportunities and support performance improvement plans. 

• Track audit results and document quality observations accurately and consistently. 

• Participate in team calibrations and training sessions to maintain scoring consistency. 

• Support implementation of new processes, tools, and initiatives through quality monitoring and feedback. 

• Assist in reporting quality performance metrics and identifying individual coaching needs. 

• Provide insights regarding customer experience concerns and recurring agent behaviors. 

• Assist with service level support as needed through customer interaction activities, which will consist of helping with phone coverage when needed. 

• Utilize Level AI and other quality intelligence platforms to review customer interactions, identify performance opportunities, and validate audit findings. 

• Leverage AI-generated insights to improve coaching effectiveness and highlight opportunities to enhance customer experience. 

• Review automated quality scoring and conversation intelligence outputs to ensure accuracy and consistency with established QA standards. 

• Identify customer experience and sales trends surfaced through AI-enabled reporting and escalate findings to leadership when appropriate. 

• Maintain proficiency in AI tools and adopt new capabilities that improve quality monitoring efficiency and effectiveness.

 What You Will Bring As A Quality Assurance Specialist 

• 1+ year of quality assurance, coaching, customer service, or sales experience. 

• Strong written and verbal communication skills. 

• Ability to provide constructive coaching and feedback. 

• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills. 

• Experience working in a sales or customer service call center environment. 

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other reporting tools. 

• Ability to adapt to changing priorities and business needs. 

• Passion for employee development and customer experience excellence. 

• Experience working with AI-powered quality monitoring, conversation intelligence, or contact center analytics tools preferred. 

• Ability to interpret AI-generated insights and apply sound judgment when evaluating customer interactions. 

• Comfortable leveraging technology and automation to improve productivity and quality outcomes. 

• Proven experience working with US based business teams 

• Excellent written and communication skills in English language 

• This role requires full and ongoing overlap with Porch's U.S. Eastern Time business hours (7:30 PM IST – 3:30 AM IST). A Night Shift Allowance is applicable for this position in line with company policy. 

• Workspace: A quiet space to work, an internet connection of at least 30 Mbps download | 10 Mbps upload 

 The application window for this position is anticipated to close in 2 weeks (10 business days) from October 19, 2026. Please know this may change based on business and interviewing needs. 
 What You Will Get As A Porch Group Team Member 
 Pay Range: 600,000 – 840,000 INR annually 
 *Please know your actual pay at Porch will reflect a number of factors among which are your work experience and skillsets, job-related knowledge, alignment with market and our Porch employees, as well as your geographic location. 
 Our benefits package will provide you with comprehensive coverage for your health, life, and financial well-being. 

• Our benefits include medical insurance, accident insurance and retiral benefits. 

• Our wellness programs include 12 company-paid holidays, 2 flexible holidays, privilege/earned leave, casual/sick leave, paid maternity and paternity Leaves, and weekly wellness events.

 What’s next? 
 Submit your application below and our Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing your application shortly! If your resume gets us intrigued, we will look to connect with you for a chat to learn more about your background, and then possibly invite you to have virtual interviews. What's important to call out is that we want to make sure not only that you're the right person for us, but also that we're the right next step for you, so come prepared with all the questions you have! 
 Porch is committed to building an inclusive culture of belonging that not only embraces the diversity of our people but also reflects the diversity of the communities in which we work and the customers we serve. We know that the happiest and highest performing teams include people with diverse perspectives that encourage new ways of solving problems, so we strive to attract and develop talent from all backgrounds and create workplaces where everyone feels seen, heard and empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work. 
 Porch is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
